name: Entombed Elite Guard
description: An elite undead soldier buried with their empress to defend the tomb from theft and desecration.

abilities.name: Battle Formation
abilities.description: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each ally within Very Close range.

abilities.name: Javelin
abilities.description: Make an attack against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.
